description: This PHP source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CustomFieldSearchFilterParams' used for filtering custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM Plugin module. It extends a base FilterParams class, allowing setting and retrieving filtering options such as 'screen' and 'fieldNumbers'.

classes.name: CustomFieldSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for managing search filter parameters related to custom fields in the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'cf.name'.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current screen filter value.

methods.name: getFieldNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the array of field numbers used for filtering.

methods.name: setFieldNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of field numbers used for filtering.
